No. U....................

SUBJECT: Mr. H. Kaufmann

The following is the result of
enquiries about Mr. H. Kaufmann:-

Mr. Kaufmann was born in South
Germany, Baden, and is about 70 years of age. Being of
Jewish origin, he had to leave Germany in 1939 and went
to France, where he lived until July 1940. On the 2nd
of July of that year he went aboard the French steamer
the "Paul Doumer". Although he had no visa for
Singapore he left the boat in this port in order to
stay with a British girl to which he stated he was en-
gaged at the time.

In Singapore he tried to obtain
a job but finally got in touch with a person in Dr. Sidney
S. Smith, who was employed in some capacity with the
Singapore Municipality. In 1941 his friend Smit Smith he
worked for about two or three months for a British
propaganda publication, but lost this job for reasons
unknown to my informant.

He then came to Shanghai in December
1939, and he tried vainly to get a job with the "North
China Daily News". Failing this he took the job of getting
advertisements for Asia newspapers. Later he joined the
Asiawe (1941). At that time he also made the acquaintance
of an officer of the German Consulate, whose name is not
known to my informant, and Kaufmann worked for this
officer, as a sort of routine regularly every day
at the Palace Hotel.

Nothing is known about his present
activities and it is said he is always short of money.

主题：H. 考夫曼先生

以下是关于 H. 考夫曼先生的调查结果：-

考夫曼先生出生于德国南部巴登地区，现年约70岁。因具有犹太血统，他于1939年被迫离开德国前往法国，并在那里居住至1940年7月。同年7月2日，他登上了法国轮船“保罗·杜梅”号（Paul Doumer）。尽管他没有新加坡的签证，但他为了与一位据称当时已与其订婚的英国女子同居，而在该港口下了船。

在新加坡，他试图寻找工作，但最终通过西德尼·S·史密斯博士（Dr. Sidney S. Smith）结识了一人，此人在新加坡市政机构担任某种职务。1941年，他的朋友史密斯（Smit Smith [原文如此]）为他安排了一份在英国宣传刊物工作的工作，他干了大约两三个月，但因我的线人所不知的原因失去了这份工作。

随后，他于1939年12月来到上海，并徒劳地试图在《字林西报》（North China Daily News）谋得职位。未果后，他接受了为《亚洲文汇》（Asia newspapers [注：此处原文可能指代特定报刊或泛指亚洲系报纸，结合下文Asiawe，暂直译]）拉取广告的工作。后来，他加入了《亚细亚》杂志（Asiawe，1941年）。在此期间，他还结识了德国领事馆的一名官员，我的线人不知其姓名，考夫曼每天定期在礼查饭店（Palace Hotel）为这名官员做一些日常事务性工作。

目前对他的活动一无所知，据说他总是缺钱。
